subject: Burnouts Biggest Fan!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Thank you Yabbas, that would be me. I am typing this while proudly sitting in BurnoutAholics HQ with a GIGANTIC framed Revenge poster on the wall behind me and 3 signed Paradise concept art prints and a unique Revenge "Forgiveness is for Losers" framed poster on other walls. All very gratefully received gifts from Alex Ward himself.. he is the man! I am very proud of the Burnout memorabelia I have, and it takes pride of place in my home.

I was critical of Burnout Paradise, but that doesn't change my love of the series, or the tongue in cheek attitude that this blog had when I wrote it.

Glad to see you and DB contributing to this site.. The Best Burnout Fansite on the Web! 🙂

😛

subject: Jinno
author: Rofer
body: I think you should stop playing revenge, by doing that you are supporting criterion by being a revenge fan.

subject: LOL...
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
No... I like Revenge... Just not a Fan of Criterion, nor am I a fan of Paradise... but I like Revenge... Nothing wrong with that... not that its a bad thing... because I dont see why people make a big deal of Criterion? Its news, podcasts..ect.??? If Criterion made Revenge tracks, I would be happy about it, but I still wouldnt be a Criterion fan nor will I be a fan of EA, or whatever else company is there.. Id buy their games, but just because their logo is there, doesnt mean I will get it.. u know what I mean?... I like C&C for example, I would get into it.. But Im buying it because its fun, not because it was made by EA... I can see how people would be fans of Paradise.. its just not me... not Bashing it, just not a fan of it...

.... if your going to ask me whether Im a fan of Burnout? I like Revenge, I got into... Im still in it... I like that Burnout game, I def like Revenge... I cant truly say Im a Burnout fan cause I dont like Paradise, but I cant say I would consider myself a Burnout fan either to begin with even tho I like Revenge... I like Burnout, but Im not really that into Burnout.... I play it because a lot of online friends play it.. thats pretty much why I still play it.. Otherwise it would be boring as usual....

 

Did I hit a nerve Suffer?

 

 

-----------------------------

"There's Jinno, One of the Twin Angels" - DjSubzero18 (Burnout Revenge Online, 3/20/ 2009).
